header.unit: cost is in the entry baseline's unit: 1 per value entered or picked from the top four, 2 for a pick further down, 1.5 for a wrong proposal (it can ship), 0 for a right one
header.ranking: potential = breadth (sites affected / sites) × depth (mean cost per affected row) × mean P of the affected sites; headline is drop mode, both orders; only POOL-labelled classes are high potential
